item.title: Version 1.5.0
item.description:
Apps stay in the VPN

Quitting an app used to quietly take it out of the VPN. Now the switch is a lasting choice: open the app again from anywhere and it rejoins the tunnel on its own.

No more vanishing into the menu bar

If your menu bar is full, macOS hides the newest icon without saying so. VPNonly now opens in a window with a Dock icon instead of looking like it failed to launch.

Updates install themselves

From here on, updates install with one click and macOS won't ask you to approve the app again.
